detailed_descriptions.en: Oh no!! Your precious friend has been infected with the terrifying Yandere Virus! What started as a fun trip with your friends has turned into a nightmare in an instant. When you come to your senses, you find yourself in a mysterious place, and your dear friend has been infected with the “Yandere Virus.” Explore this unknown place alone, or together with your friends. Gather scattered materials to craft a cure, save your friend and escape this place. Run away from your Yandere friend Your infected friend is no longer who they used to be. Driven by a distorted mind and uncontrollable aggression, they will chase after you, taunting you with unsettling and disturbing whispers. The moment you get caught, it’s all over. If you want to survive—run. Collect Platonic Pumpkins Mysterious “Platonic Pumpkins” are hidden throughout this graveyard. These pumpkins are essential ingredients for creating the cure. Risk your life to collect them, and complete the only cure that can save your friend. Beware of Mutated Plants Mutated plants lurk all around the graveyard, waiting to attack you. Just when you think you've escaped your Yandere friend, they will strike without warning. Play Solo or Together with Friends You can face this horror alone, or with your friends. Invite up to 3 friends on Steam and enjoy intense cooperative gameplay. Game Features Up to 4 players (online co-op / single-player supported) Proximity Voice Chat Support Relentless pursuit from friends infected with the Yandere Virus Platonic Pumpkin collection and cure crafting system Unpredictable attacks from dangerous mutated plants

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Oh no!! Your precious friend has been infected with the terrifying Yandere Virus!


What started as a fun trip with your friends has turned into a nightmare in an instant.
When you come to your senses, you find yourself in a mysterious place,
and your dear friend has been infected with the “Yandere Virus.”

Explore this unknown place alone, or together with your friends.
Gather scattered materials to craft a cure,
save your friend and escape this place.

Run away from your Yandere friend


Your infected friend is no longer who they used to be.
Driven by a distorted mind and uncontrollable aggression, they will chase after you, taunting you with unsettling and disturbing whispers.

The moment you get caught, it’s all over.
If you want to survive—run.

Collect Platonic Pumpkins


Mysterious “Platonic Pumpkins” are hidden throughout this graveyard.
These pumpkins are essential ingredients for creating the cure.

Risk your life to collect them,
and complete the only cure that can save your friend.

Beware of Mutated Plants


Mutated plants lurk all around the graveyard, waiting to attack you.
Just when you think you've escaped your Yandere friend,
they will strike without warning.

Play Solo or Together with Friends


You can face this horror alone, or with your friends.
Invite up to 3 friends on Steam and enjoy intense cooperative gameplay.

Game Features

  • Up to 4 players (online co-op / single-player supported)
  • Proximity Voice Chat Support
  • Relentless pursuit from friends infected with the Yandere Virus
  • Platonic Pumpkin collection and cure crafting system
  • Unpredictable attacks from dangerous mutated plants
